ad_library.summary: Eastman New Energy is running 4 active Telugu ads on Meta (Aug 29 - Sep 29, 2026) - on-grid and hybrid creatives, both selling the Rs. 78,000 PM Surya Ghar subsidy plus an additional state subsidy - and all four send the click to eastmansolar.in. Eastman is not a local installer: the site is a manufacturer's product catalogue (800 MW in-house panel manufacturing, 1000+ distributors, 400+ OEM partners, part of the Eastman group's 25 GW production).

funnel.meaning: At least the spend lands on an owned site. But the destination is a manufacturer's product catalogue - on-grid, off-grid and hybrid inverter pages - while the ads promise a B2C subsidy. The gap between the ad promise and the page is where the conversion leaks.

findings: 4 live Telugu ads (Aug 29 - Sep 29, 2026), on-grid and hybrid creatives, all pointing at eastmansolar.in - the spend stays on an owned domain.
But the destination is a manufacturer's catalogue: 800 MW in-house panel manufacturing, 1000+ distributors, 400+ OEM partners, panels from 50W to 590W - a B2B story for ads selling a B2C subsidy.
The enquiry form runs behind reCAPTCHA and a character-limited 'claim your subsidy of Rs 78,000' field - friction between the ad promise and the lead.
Every ad ends with the same 80016 80016 short-code number - a call-centre funnel, not a local-installer one.
Scale note: this is the solar arm of the Eastman group (25 GW group-wide production), not a local installer - the pitch here is the B2C funnel, not the product.
next_steps: Build a dedicated residential PM Surya Ghar page
The ad promise is 'reduce your bill to zero with Rs 78,000 subsidy'. The page should be a residential subsidy calculator and quote form, not the inverter catalogue.
reCAPTCHA plus a limited field on a Rs 78,000 offer loses clicks. Fewer fields, no captcha on the first step.
Install pixel and retargeting on the offer
4 ads on one offer with no pixel means no way to see who dropped off after the click and no audience to bring back.
Test on-grid vs hybrid against the page
Two creatives selling two product lines to one funnel - a landing page per line tells you which converts.

controls.name: Meta Pixel installed
controls.evidence: Landing page was not source-checked for this report; needs a page-source pull or account access.

controls.name: UTM parameters on ad destinations
controls.evidence: Destination URL captured but parameter list not verified; needs the full click-through URL from Ads Manager.

controls.name: Domain verification
controls.evidence: Business Manager domain verification cannot be observed from public ad data; needs account access.

controls.name: Creative format diversity
controls.evidence: Ad-card formats were not captured for these ads.

controls.name: Creative concept coverage
controls.evidence: Only 2 offer angle in live copy (government subsidy, subsidy amount) - every ad says the same thing.

controls.name: Social proof utilization
controls.evidence: No social proof (customer counts, reviews, testimonials) in the live ad copy.

controls.name: Video aspect ratios
controls.evidence: Creative files cannot be downloaded from the Ad Library; needs account access or the raw creatives.

controls.name: UGC / social-native content
controls.evidence: Content style cannot be verified from ad cards alone.

controls.name: CTR benchmark
controls.evidence: No spend or impression data is public for this advertiser; the catalog forbids benchmark guessing.

controls.name: Creative freshness
controls.evidence: Live creatives include recent launches (newest started Sep 29, 2026) - the account is not running one stale ad forever.

controls.name: Campaign fragmentation
controls.evidence: 4 distinct live ads visible - enough running to compare messages against each other.

controls.name: Campaign objective alignment
controls.evidence: Ad CTA and destination agree on one job: Own website (enquiry form behind reCAPTCHA).

controls.name: Creative fatigue detection
controls.evidence: Frequency and performance decay need account metrics.

ads_audit.methodology: Control review follows the claude-ads Meta Ads audit catalog (github.com/vamsy16/claude-ads, ads/references/meta-audit.md). Each control is graded only where public evidence establishes it - Ad Library ad data and the lead's own landing page. Controls that require Ads Manager access (bidding, budgets, audiences, learning phase, EMQ, CAPI status) are marked unknown on purpose: they cannot be verified from outside the account and are never guessed.
